content.comment_body: Hello. I have programs compiled with [product_name] [version_no] on my microSD card, and I want to know if they will work properly with [article_no]. Do I need to install [version_no] and recompile them?

Yes, that's possible. You can load the [version_no] program in [product_name] [version_no]. Then, in the device selection, change the hardware from [product_name] [version_no] to [product_name] [version_no], and save the program.
You can download the upgrade to [product_name] [version_no] from here: [url]
Thank you. So I cannot simply load the program from my SD card to the device; I need to update the software before doing this.
It's advisable to update the software first. This will help you avoid potential issues.
Thanks, I'll proceed with the update.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are concerned about whether programs compiled with older versions of [product_name] can be used directly on newer hardware and software versions. There is uncertainty regarding the need to recompile with the latest software for proper compatibility. The general recommendation is to update and recompile as a precaution, suggesting that backward compatibility may not be seamless.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect that programs compiled with older software versions should work on newer hardware without additional steps, such as recompilation or software upgrade.
